Harper: Quick one — noticed the rate-limits + metrics doc still references `redwood_rate_limit_total`. Prom infra now exposes `rwd_rate_limits_total` (we renamed metrics in the telemetry cleanup). Also the Rust snippet uses the old header `X-Req-Count`. I opened PR to update both: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001 — can @Diego @Faye take a look?
Diego: On it. I'll swap the metric name, update the Grafana permalink (was pointing to an internal folder), and add a short note about label changes (region/env deduping). Will push a commit in ~20m.
Faye: I'll update the Rust + Python snippets to prefer the SDK usage helpers and include a Rust reqwest example that demonstrates `X-Usage-Tokens`. I'll also add a tiny FAQ row about why a Prom counter might be slightly higher than SDK-aggregated usage (scraping interval + dedupe).
Harper: Also can we add a small interactive calc example — folks keep asking how to estimate cost for embeddings. Something copyable (formula + JS one-liner) would help support paste.
Diego: Good idea. I'll also regenerate the dashboard JSON (grafana) and replace the permalink with the public metering panel. Opening PR 9002 for the dashboard permalink + metric rename.
LinkBot: link-check: old grafana URL 403 -> flagged. New permalink in PR 9002 resolves 200 on staging.
Faye: Draft Rust snippet I'll add (short):
```rust
// Rust: fetch usage header and parse tokens
let resp = client.get("/v1/embeddings")
    .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", api_key))
    .send().await?;
let tokens = resp.headers().get("X-Usage-Tokens").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("0").parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0);
println!("tokens this request: {}", tokens);
```
Faye: For reviewers: I'll keep the SDK-first pattern (client.usage.fetch_range) above this raw-header example. Also adding migration blurb mapping `X-Req-Count` -> `X-Usage-Tokens` and `X-Burst-Left` -> `X-Burst-Remaining`.
Harper: For the calc, simple copyable snippet like: `tokens = Math.ceil(chars/4); cost = (tokens/1000)*pricePerK` and a one-liner example: `((Math.ceil(1200/4)/1000)*0.05).toFixed(4)` — shows quick $ estimate. Can you slot that in the examples section?
Diego: Will add the calc snippet and update the pricing-table example JSON to include per-1000-token unit. Note: ensure the downloadable CSV and pricing-table.json match. I'll open a small follow-up for the CSV if needed.
CI-Bot: ci: lint OK on PRs 9001, 9002; examples-smoke queued for python+rust; link-check re-run queued.
LinkBot: re-check: grafana permalink updated in 9002, no 403s.
Faye: Pushed snippets + migration text to 9001. Included the FAQ line: "Why do Prom counters differ from SDK totals?" answer: scraping window, label dedupe, and export sampling. Kept it short.
CI-Bot: examples-smoke: python+rust passed. link-check passed. All green.
Harper: Plan merge order: Diego (dashboard) -> Faye (snippets) -> Harper (calc + changelog). Diego, please merge when link CI green so Faye can rebase.
Diego: Merged PR 9002 (grafana permalink + metric rename).
Faye: Rebased 9001 and pushed fix for a tiny markdown linting nit. PR 9001 updated.
CI-Bot: all checks passed for 9001.
Harper: Merged 9001, then landed my tiny PR that added the JS calc + changelog blurb and a support-ready paste: "Embeddings billed per-token; updated header names; public metering dashboard link".
Harper: Thanks all. If we see any support tickets about this, point to the new FAQ item and the public graph. If anyone wants a deeper example (e.g., tokenization edge-cases), I'll draft a follow-up with tokenizer samples in Rust + Go.
CI-Bot: changelog: automated entry created and notifications sent to #support and #docs.
